description.value: VISTA at Black Forest Day Lodge is a ski resort restaurant located within Big White Ski Resort near Kelowna, BC. It operates as part of Big White's dining offerings in a controlled recreational area on the mountain. Touring cyclists visiting during the resort's open summer season may find it a remote but scenic food stop within the resort.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real restaurant ('VISTA at Black Forest Day Lodge') operating within Big White Ski Resort. However, the site prominently states 'The resort is closed until July 1. No public access is permitted within the controlled recreational area,' indicating seasonal closure at time of review. The website content is almost entirely site-wide navigation with no page-specific content about amenities, menu, or facilities for this specific venue. OSM tags are minimal (amenity=restaurant, building=yes, name only), providing no amenity data.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Black Forest Day Lodge' but the website page title is 'VISTA at Black Forest Day Lodge' — the restaurant operating in this building appears to be branded 'VISTA', not 'Black Forest Day Lodge'.
Resort is currently closed until July 1 with no public access permitted to the controlled recreational area.
Access to this venue requires entering Big White Ski Resort's controlled recreational area, which may require a resort pass or fee — accessibility for casual drop-in touring cyclists is uncertain.
Website content returned only site-wide navigation; no venue-specific amenity details were available.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating seasonal restaurant within Big White Ski Resort; currently in off-season closure but will reopen. Useful to touring cyclists during open season, particularly given the resort's summer eBike tour offerings.
